current.subject: Recap: meter data load demo
current.body:
Hi Hugo,

Thanks for joining today. Kofi loaded the meter readings file you sent, partitioned by region. It took about 4 minutes. He also showed a daily usage view by region.

Kofi will send you the load summary so you have it.

You mentioned that operations probably makes the decision, but you are not sure who. Could you let me know who in operations we should include? No next meeting is set yet, so a time that works for you and that person would be a good next step.

Thanks again,
Mia

original.subject: Recap: meter data load demo
original.body:
Hi Hugo,

Thanks for joining today. Kofi loaded the meter readings file you sent and partitioned it by region. It took about 4 minutes. He also showed a daily usage view by region.

Kofi will send you the load summary so you have it. No send date was given on the call; we will tell you when it is sent.

You mentioned that you set up access and are not the one who decides, and that operations is probably the right group. Would you be able to tell us who in operations owns meter data loads? If it helps, the load summary is written so you can forward it to them.

Thanks again,
Mia
